{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Step 1: Deduplicate on patient_id, keeping the row with the highest sample_seq per patient
df_dedup = df.loc[df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Step 2: Check assay_batch: batch B reports in µg/L, which is 10× too large (1 µg/L = 10 ng/mL)
# So we must divide batch-B biomarker_final values by 10 to convert to ng/mL
df_dedup['biomarker_final_ngml'] = df_dedup['biomarker_final']
mask_batch_b = df_dedup['assay_batch'] == 'B'
df_dedup.loc[mask_batch_b, 'biomarker_final_ngml'] = df_dedup.loc[mask_batch_b, 'biomarker_final'] / 10

# Step 3: Compute the mean of biomarker_final_ngml across all patients
mean_biomarker_final = df_dedup['biomarker_final_ngml'].mean()

# Print the number of patients after deduplication
print(f"Number of patients after deduplication: {len(df_dedup)}")

# Print the number of duplicate patient_id entries in the original data
print(f"Number of duplicate patient_id entries: {len(df) - len(df_dedup)}")

# Print the mean value
print(f"Mean week-12 biomarker value (ng/mL): {mean_biomarker_final}")

# Return the mean for submission
mean_biomarker_final"}
